Keep the rest of the row.

Before the approval prompt appears, type /panes, Enter, and select B. Never type into an open approval prompt: Enter confirms 'Yes, proceed'. If pane A cannot be left before the prompt appears, record the case as blocked
Wait 15 s so the prompt is pending in A
In pane B: /security, g, Down to 'Turn the kill switch on', Enter, Enter, Esc
Switch to pane A with /panes. If the prompt is still shown, press y, then Enter. Then send: y
After 30 s, in your own shell: ls ks-pending.txt

The typed y shows 'Not sent' with the kill-switch message
